text: Is the best way to learn stuff by reading a book or going to lectures and such? I don't think so, personally. The year is 1088 and Bologna opens the first university for the smartest people across the world. A thousand years later, the system hasn't changed because while universities cost more than ever, 40% of students will drop out before they finish their degree. I have ADHD. I managed school. I did get the good grades but it was very tough. Everyone learns differently. It's a system that needs to be personalized and adapt for every human that learns in different ways.
